article.title: Rainwater stagnates on GST Road between Chromepet, Pallavaram

records.detail: A brief spell of rain for less than an hour on Monday afternoon has left GST Road flooded between Chromepet and Pallavaram, making navigation a struggle for commuters.
records.source_title: Rainwater stagnates on GST Road between Chromepet, Pallavaram
records.locality_as_written: GST Road between Chromepet and Pallavaram

records.detail: The sudden downpour led to waterlogging in several areas of Chromepet, with storm water drains overflowing and mixing with sewage along nearly 1-km of the Chennai-Tiruchy National Highway.
